integrity: The statement has an all-odd-prime-power proof and a standalone direct-equation checker for six prime-field cases. Computational tests are limited checks, not a proof of the quantified theorem.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields and targets with nonzero nilpotent sl2 projection only; other sl2 strata and characteristic two are not classified. Previously known finite-field quadratic-form counts are used as input. Indexed searches do not prove absolute historical priority.
title: Three-level bracket-fiber law on nilpotent slices of Schrödinger Lie algebras
